methodologyNotes: Re-verified against each vendor's official pricing page (maze.co/pricing, lookback.com/pricing, useberry.com/pricing, lyssna.com/pricing, userlytics.com/pricing, playbookux.com/pricing, userinterviews.com/pricing, usertesting.com/pricing) on 2026-06-19, plus official security/help-center pages and 2026 aggregators for JS-rendered figures. Confirmed: Maze Free $0 + Starter $99/mo (help center + aggregators; main page price is JS-rendered); Lyssna Growth $199/mo monthly and $165/mo annual; Userlytics Premium $699/mo and Advanced $999/mo BOTH shown directly on official page (prior draft wrongly claimed Advanced was aggregator-only); PlaybookUX Scale $5,400/yr and Pro $8,800/yr on official page, Grow $267/$290 via aggregators; User Interviews and UserTesting confirmed as per-session and quote-only respectively. Quote-only / custom / per-seat tiers carry monthlyUsd:null (a null beats a guess; no FX conversions invented). Useberry publishes EUR only with no USD toggle, so Growth/Business carry monthlyUsd:null with EUR figures recorded in notes. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

vendors.name: Maze
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page maze.co/pricing renders plan prices via client-side JS not captured by fetch. Free $0 (perpetual) and Starter $99/mo confirmed via Maze help center and multiple 2026 aggregators (checkthat.ai, vendr, g2). Four-tier structure Free/Starter/Organization/Enterprise confirmed. Compliance from maze.co/security; 30-day trial from help.maze.co.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Perpetual free tier. 1 active study/month, 1 active project, up to 3 mazes per project, 5 seats, 2,000 responses/study cap. Pay-per-use panel credits separate. No credit card required.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $99/month. 1 study/month, 5 seats, clips (audio/video/screen recording), live website testing, pay-per-use panel credits. Confirmed via Maze help center and 2026 aggregators (main pricing page price is JS-rendered).

plans.name: Organization
plans.notes: Custom per-seat pricing for larger teams; advanced collaboration, SSO, role-based permissions, higher study volumes. Contact sales — no published price.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote only. Unlimited seats, AI Moderator, AI Study Builder, mobile testing, interview studies, SSO, SAML, custom security review. Anonymized deals reportedly $12K-$62K/yr.

limits: Free: 1 study/month, 1 active project, 5 seats, 2,000 responses/study
Starter: 1 study/month, 5 seats, pay-per-use panel credits
Panel recruit credits sold separately on all self-serve plans
enrichment.provenance: SOC 2 Type II and GDPR explicitly stated on maze.co/security (HIPAA not mentioned -> null). 30-day free trial (or 3 studies) confirmed on Maze help-center free-trials article; account reverts to Free plan after trial.

vendors.name: Lookback
vendors.provenance: Official lookback.com/pricing verified 2026-06-19. All plans annual-only; monthly equivalents = annual/12. 60-day trial (5 sessions, no card) confirmed. GDPR stated; SOC2/HIPAA not stated.

plans.name: Freelance
plans.notes: Billed annually at $299/year ($24.92/mo equivalent). 10 sessions, 1 panel participant, 1 seat, unlimited guests, all core features, chat support. Additional sessions $299/10-pack; panel participants $49 each (min. 10).

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Billed annually at $1,782/year ($148.50/mo equivalent). 100 sessions, 10 panel participants, 10 collaborators, unlimited guests, Security Self-Assess. Additional sessions $178/10-pack; panel participants $38 each.

plans.name: Insights Hub
plans.notes: Billed annually at $4,122/year ($343.50/mo equivalent). 300 sessions, 30 panel participants, 30 collaborators, unlimited guests, Security Assessment Assist, priority chat support. Additional sessions $137/10-pack; panel participants $31 each.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Unlimited sessions, custom participant allocation, custom seats, SSO, invoicing/PO, custom legal, security audit, CSM support, team training. Panel participants $25 each.

keyFeatures: Live observer rooms with unlimited guests
60-day free trial with 5 sessions, no credit card
enrichment.provenance: All data from official lookback.com/pricing verified 2026-06-19. GDPR stated on pricing page; no SOC2 or HIPAA certification stated. 60-day/5-session trial is a trial, not a forever-free tier (freeTier false).

vendors.name: Useberry
vendors.provenance: Official useberry.com/pricing verified 2026-06-19. Prices in EUR only, no USD toggle. Free €0; Growth €83/mo annual; Business €659/mo annual; Enterprise custom. Paid-tier monthlyUsd left null (no USD published; no FX conversion invented).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: €0/month. 10 responses/month, 1 seat (up to 20), 1 project, 3 versions per project, 5 blocks. Permanent free tier.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: €83/month billed yearly (~€996/year; 2 months free vs monthly). 300 responses/month (up to 2,000), 1 seat (up to 20), unlimited projects/versions/blocks, 5 interviews/month, 10 transcription hours/month, 20 GB storage. Price published in EUR only; no USD on official page -> monthlyUsd null (no FX conversion invented).

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: €659/month billed yearly. 2,000 responses/month (up to 4,000), 5 seats (up to 20), 50 interviews/month, 30 transcription hours/month, 500 GB storage, AI features, Brand Kits, SAML SSO. Price published in EUR only; no USD on official page -> monthlyUsd null.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. From 48,000 responses/year, from 10 seats, 100 interviews/month, 100 transcription hours/month, 2 TB storage, AI add-on, custom branding, enhanced support, custom legal, enterprise security.

limits: All prices published in EUR only (no USD toggle)
keyFeatures: Unmoderated studies with heatmaps and click maps
enrichment.provenance: All pricing from official useberry.com/pricing verified 2026-06-19. No compliance certifications stated on pricing page (all null). Prices in EUR only; USD not published, so paid-tier monthlyUsd null rather than a guessed conversion.

vendors.name: Lyssna
vendors.provenance: Official lyssna.com/pricing verified 2026-06-19, supplemented by Lyssna help center. Growth: $199/mo monthly billing, $165/mo annual billing (~17% off). Free tier and Enterprise (custom) confirmed. SOC 2 Type II + GDPR confirmed.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 3 collaborator seats, unlimited quick studies, 15 self-recruited responses viewable, core testing methods (5-second, preference, etc.). Panel access pay-per-use. Permanent free tier, no card.

plans.name: Growth (monthly)
plans.notes: Billed monthly at $199/month. 5 collaborator seats, unlimited quick studies, 5 in-depth studies/month, unlimited self-recruited responses, AI follow-up questions, AI summaries, CSV exports, conditional logic, custom branding, recordings, live website testing.

plans.name: Growth (annual)
plans.notes: Billed annually at $165/month ($1,980/year). Same features as Growth monthly. 5 seats, 5 in-depth studies/month, unlimited quick studies, unlimited self-recruited responses. ~17% savings vs monthly.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Unlimited seats, custom in-depth study allowance, SSO, SOC 2 report access, closed spaces, custom contracts, priority support, security audit assistance, password rules, wallets.

limits: Free: 15 self-recruited responses viewable, no in-depth studies
Panel responses billed ~$1/credit separately on all plans
SOC 2 report access is an Enterprise feature (certification itself is company-wide)
keyFeatures: Quick unmoderated studies (5-second, preference, click tests)
In-depth studies with recording and transcription
AI follow-up questions and AI summaries (Growth+)
enrichment.provenance: Growth $199/mo (monthly) and $165/mo (annual) confirmed on official page and help center. SOC 2 Type II + GDPR confirmed company-wide (lyssna.com/blog/gdpr-soc-2-compliant-research-tools). Free tier is permanent (no card).

vendors.name: Userlytics
vendors.provenance: Official userlytics.com/pricing verified 2026-06-19. Premium $699/mo AND Advanced $999/mo BOTH displayed directly on the official page (prior draft wrongly claimed Advanced was aggregator-only). ISO 27001 via Userlytics press release; GDPR via privacy policy.

plans.name: Project Based
plans.notes: No subscription. Custom per-session pricing, minimum 5 sessions. Supports BYOU (bring your own users) and panel participants. Moderated, unmoderated, and quantitative testing.

plans.name: Self-Recruitment Premium
plans.notes: $699/month, billed annually (flexible payment options). 5 seats, unlimited BYOU self-recruited participants, unlimited concurrent tests. Panel participants available for purchase.

plans.name: Self-Recruitment Advanced
plans.notes: $999/month, billed annually. 10 seats, unlimited BYOU self-recruited participants for unmoderated, moderated, and quantitative sessions. Price displayed directly on the official pricing page.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: From ~$34/session with annual commitment and volume discounts. Unlimited seats. Account manager on plans over ~$12,000. 'Buy 1 Get 1 FREE' BYOU credit with panel purchases. No fixed published price.

plans.name: Limitless
plans.notes: Custom quote. Unlimited accounts, unlimited concurrent tests, unlimited participants.

limits: Annual billing required for subscription plans
keyFeatures: ISO 27001 certified; EU data hosted within EU
enrichment.provenance: Premium $699 and Advanced $999 both confirmed directly on official userlytics.com/pricing. ISO 27001 confirmed via Userlytics press release (live). GDPR confirmed in privacy policy (live). SOC2 covers cloud provider only, not Userlytics -> soc2 null.

vendors.name: PlaybookUX
vendors.provenance: Official playbookux.com/pricing verified 2026-06-19. Scale $5,400/yr ($450/mo) and Pro $8,800/yr ($733/mo) shown on official page. Grow $267/mo annual + $290/mo monthly via 2026 aggregators (Grow not rendered numerically on page). SOC2 Type II + ISO 27001 + ISO 27701 + GDPR on official page.

plans.name: Grow (annual)
plans.notes: Billed annually at $267/month ($3,204/year). 50-session annual limit with PlaybookUX panel. Panel credits: $65/participant unmoderated, $115/participant moderated. Unlimited team seats. Free trial at signup (no card).

plans.name: Grow (monthly)
plans.notes: Billed monthly at $290/month. Same features as Grow annual. 50-session limit with panel.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Billed annually at $5,400/year ($450/month equivalent; $490/mo if billed monthly). Expanded capabilities beyond Grow. Unlimited team seats, no per-seat charges.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Billed annually at $8,800/year (~$733/month equivalent). Most popular plan. Unlimited team seats, no per-seat charges, all research methods included.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing with volume discounts. Dedicated CSM, custom contracts, invoice payment, white-glove onboarding. Unlimited seats, 99.99% uptime SLA. No published price.

limits: No per-seat charges on any plan
Grow has a signup trial; no forever-free tier
keyFeatures: Moderated and unmoderated testing in one platform
No per-seat pricing — unlimited team members
SOC2 Type II, ISO 27001 and ISO 27701 certified

vendors.name: User Interviews
vendors.provenance: Official userinterviews.com/pricing verified 2026-06-19. Pricing is per-session, not flat monthly SaaS; all monthlyUsd null. SOC 2 Type II + ISO 27001 + ISO 27701 confirmed on userinterviews.com/security.

plans.name: Pay As You Go
plans.notes: $49/session moderated; $98/session unmoderated. No subscription. 6M+ participant panel, targeting, scheduling, incentives, quota tracking, integrations, AI analysis, unlimited seats. Advanced B2B targeting +$45/$49. Incentives paid separately.

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: Annual subscription, 60 sessions. $41/session moderated or $82/session unmoderated. Saves ~17% vs PAYG. Adds quota automation, re-invite, customer success. Billed annually.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Annual subscription from 250 sessions. $36/session moderated or $72/session unmoderated. Saves ~27% vs PAYG. Adds premium screening, document signing, SSO/SAML add-ons. Billed annually.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: Volume-based, 250+ sessions, lowest per-session rate. Priority support, enterprise CSM, custom onboarding, security review, negotiable contract terms. No published per-session rate.

limits: Pay As You Go: per-session billing, no volume discount
Incentives not included in session fees on any plan
keyFeatures: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and ISO 27701 certified

vendors.name: UserTesting
vendors.provenance: Official usertesting.com/pricing verified 2026-06-19 — all three tiers (Advanced, Ultimate, Ultimate+) are quote-only with NO published prices (all monthlyUsd null). HIPAA + BAA confirmed via UserTesting help center PHI/HIPAA article and usertesting.com/baa.

plans.name: Advanced

plans.name: Ultimate

plans.name: Ultimate+

Free single test available on website (no platform access)

AI-powered analysis, smart tags, and Insights Hub (Ultimate+)
Both test-based consumption and unlimited team billing models
